findings.title: Student list is public and leaks Aadhaar and PAN
findings.explanation: GET /api/students answers 200 with no login and returns name, phone, dob, aadhaar and parent_pan for every student. Anyone on the network can read all personal data.
findings.severity_reason: Critical: no login needed, 15 records returned with name, phone, dob, aadhaar, parent_pan.
findings.recommendation: Require authentication and authorisation on this route and return only the fields the caller needs.

evidence.summary: Unauthenticated GET /api/students returned 200 with 15 records containing aadhaar and parent_pan.

findings.title: Signup logs email and Aadhaar in plaintext
findings.explanation: The signup handler passes email and aadhaar into logger.info. Anyone with log access can read them, and logs are rarely access controlled.
findings.severity_reason: High: email, aadhaar written to a log in plain text.
findings.recommendation: Log an internal id instead of personal data, and mask any value that must be logged.

clauses.note: encryption, obfuscation, masking or virtual tokens

evidence.summary: logger.info call includes the variables email and aadhaar.

findings.title: Aadhaar stored in a plaintext column
findings.explanation: students.aadhaar holds 12-digit numbers that pass the Verhoeff check, stored as plain text. A copy of the database file exposes every number.
findings.severity_reason: High: aadhaar stored unencrypted in students.
findings.recommendation: Encrypt Aadhaar and PAN at rest, or store a token or masked form, and limit who can read the columns.

clauses.note: encryption, obfuscation, masking or virtual tokens

evidence.summary: 20 of 20 sampled rows in students.aadhaar are valid Aadhaar numbers in plaintext.

findings.title: Facebook pixel loads before any consent click
findings.explanation: The signup page requests connect.facebook.net as soon as it opens, with no click from the user. This is a marketing tracker on a page where children may sign up.
findings.severity_reason: High: connect.facebook.net (Advertising) is contacted before any consent click.
findings.recommendation: Do not load third party trackers until the user gives clear consent. Load them only from the consent handler.

clauses.note: consent must be free, specific, informed, unambiguous, clear affirmative action
no tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted ads aimed at children

evidence.summary: Page load with zero clicks sent a request to connect.facebook.net, classified as Advertising by the Disconnect list.

findings.title: Consent box is pre-ticked and bundled into T&C
findings.explanation: The signup consent checkbox is ticked by default and covers the terms and conditions. The notice does not itemise the personal data collected.
findings.severity_reason: Medium: consent is pre ticked and bundled with the terms.
findings.recommendation: Use a separate, unticked consent box for each purpose and itemise the data and purposes in the notice.

clauses.note: consent must be free, specific, informed, unambiguous, clear affirmative action
notice stands alone, plain language, itemises personal data and specific purposes

evidence.summary: input#consent is checked on page load and its label links to the terms and conditions.
